summary: VisionWave Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing a term sheet to form a joint venture with Lucky Whale Production Limited for a Tier IV data center project in Israel. The joint company would be 68%-owned by VisionWave and 32% by the sponsor, with VisionWave holding a ~51% effective indirect interest. Consideration is ~$40 million in VisionWave common stock to the landowner, subject to stockholder approval and Nasdaq rules. The company must arrange construction financing. This is a strategic JV, not a standard M&A; no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch definitive agreement and shareholder vote.
